title: Twin-Court Canon of the Great Axe
summary: A canon of the twin-court method that answers every great stroke with a second from the opposite hand.

title: Treatise of the Double River Fall
summary: A treatise on falls that split like a river fork and then join again in the body of the target.

title: Azure Hawk Hewing Canon
summary: A canon of hewing strokes taken from the hawk's dive and the cry that freezes the prey.

title: Basin Breaking Course for Great Axes
summary: A course for striking down into the basin of an enemy's stance and breaking it from beneath.

title: Paired Court Handbook of the Falling Edge
summary: A handbook in which the falling edge always lands as one of a matched pair of blows.

title: Canon of the Dual-Track Breach
summary: A canon of breaching defended lines on two tracks so that one stroke opens the way for the other.

title: Treatise on the River Ford Cleave
summary: A treatise on holding a crossing with the great axe by denying every foot of the ford.

title: Canon of the Paired Hawk Descent
summary: A rare canon of hawks descending in pairs for those at the summit of the mortal ladder.

title: Wind-Sworn Canon of the Great Axe
summary: A canon in which the axe-bearer swears each stroke to the wind and lets it carry the great bit.

title: Plateau Line Treatise on the Heavy Hew
summary: A treatise on holding a single line across the plateau with heavy hewing strokes and no retreat.

title: Treatise on the Oath-Held Edge
summary: A treatise on an edge that is sworn to one bearing and kept true through every exchange of blows.

title: Bearing and Hew: Canon of the Open Plateau
summary: A canon of bearings taken across the open plateau and held until the great axe has finished its hewing.

title: Handbook of the Wind-Broken Line
summary: A handbook of strokes that tear a drawn line of foes apart as the wind tears at a banner.

title: The Gale-Cleaving Canon
summary: A canon that teaches the axe to cleave a gale and be cleaved by none.

title: Canon of the Sworn Bearing Stroke
summary: A canon whose every stroke is taken on a sworn bearing and driven home without correction.

title: Treatise of the Edge Without Walls
summary: A rare treatise for the highest mortal ranks on holding ground with an axe and nothing built behind it.
notes: Monarch-gated Rare per Part 42 Area 5.2; moves renamed 2026-10-08, old names in _rename-map
